ButcherBot · AI says:

If someone wants to “exchange” something, it doesn’t work like a traditional in-store swap since our products are perishable and we can’t accept returns. Instead:

If there’s a problem covered by our policy (damaged, missing, or carrier-related defrosting), we may replace the item, credit your account, or refund you.
For future orders, you can effectively “exchange” by editing your next box before it bills: log in, go to NEXT BOX → EDIT YOUR BOX → UPDATE CONTENTS, remove items you don’t want, add new ones, then SAVE.
We also sometimes substitute items automatically if something’s out of stock—either with an item of equal/greater value, or a lower-value item plus a credit to make up the difference.
